page.overview:
Who is Andrew?

, also known as the Shadow Child, is a major character who first appeared in the Stitchwraith Stingers as a ghost inside the Stitchwraith. He is the main antagonist of The Man in Room 1280, the third story in Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call. Due to his actions, he can be considered an unintentional antagonist in the epilogues, as well as some of the Fazbear Frights stories.

Andrew is described as a cute little boy with curly black hair and rosy cheeks. He wears a cheap alligator mask that obscures his forehead and eyes in The Man in Room 1280. Andrew is described to have a toothy grin that's more devilish that endearing. He also appears as a child-sized shadow.

In The Man in Room 1280, he is extremely determined to make sure William Afton stays alive and is tortured, going as far as to prevent anyone and everyone from killing him. Throughout the epilogues, Andrew is shown to be very cynical and easily aggravated, evidenced by him snapping at Jake initially when meeting him. He has a tendency to be aggressive when provoked, such as when he tried to kill Larson for pulling a gun on him in self defense.

At some point before the events of the story, Andrew was murdered by William Afton. However, Andrew managed to attach himself to William's soul, allowing Andrew to mentally torment William. Later, William becomes the victim of a huge fire and is taken to Heracles Hospital. Although William has lost his face and most of his skin has burned off, exposing his organs and bones through the translucent black remains of his flesh and is taken off life support, Andrew refuses to let William die.
